summary: Brera Holdings PLC (Solmate Infrastructure, Nasdaq: SLMT) filed a 6-K announcing a registered direct offering of 2,298,000 Class B ordinary shares at $4.97 per share, with gross proceeds of ~$11.4 million. The offering is led by CEO Ron Sade and board member Keren Maimon, priced at a premium to market price. It relies on an existing effective shelf registration statement (F-3). Expected close is May 27, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This capital raise, though insider-led, is a primary issuance by the company, not an issuer tender. Watch for dilution impact and whether insider participation signals confidence.
